charge: Felony Feather Destruction and Pillow Mayhem

dialogue.speaker: judge
dialogue.line: Order in the court! This feather fiasco requires immediate attention.

dialogue.speaker: prosecution
dialogue.line: Your Honor, Buddy tore apart our client's pillows, leaving a feathery crime scene.

dialogue.speaker: defense
dialogue.line: But Your Honor, it was merely an innocent case of puppy exuberance!

dialogue.speaker: judge
dialogue.line: Buddy, did you consult the Pillow Destruction Act before your fluffy rampage?

dialogue.speaker: defense
dialogue.line: Your Honor, in the case of Woof vs. Fluff, the court ruled in favor of canine curiosity!

dialogue.speaker: prosecution
dialogue.line: We rest our case, your Honor.

dialogue.speaker: judge
dialogue.line: Buddy, you're off the hook this time. Case dismissed.

verdict_reason: Innocent until proven guilty, and Buddy's defense was undeniably paw-suasive.
